name: Pine Point: Insomniac
source:
You’re Nil.

Fishing at Lost Lake, trashing the popular kids’ cars, and playing in your shitty garage band are all things you’d rather be doing than working a dead-end job that will probably keep you trapped in Pine Point for the rest of your life. 

Fortunately, you get to work alongside your best friend, Dimitri. Unfortunately, Dimitri is leaving town at the end of the summer… and you’re not.

---

Pine Point: Insomniac is a short, surreal slice-of-life visual novel following Nil, a severely sleep-deprived slacker, as he tries to survive the day at work with his best friend, Dimitri. 

[From [url=https://zeddyzi.itch.io/pine-point-insomniac]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是尼尔。

在Lost Lake钓鱼、扔掉受欢迎的儿童汽车、在糟糕的车库乐队中演奏这些都是你宁愿做的事情，也不愿从事一份可能让你余生被困在Pine Point的没有出路的工作。

幸运的是，你可以和你最好的朋友迪米特里一起工作。不幸的是，迪米特里将在夏末离开小镇……而你却没有。

---

《Pine Point: Insomniac》是一部简短的、超现实的生活片段视觉小说，讲述了尼尔（Nil），一个严重睡眠不足的懒鬼，与他最好的朋友迪米特里（Dimitri）一起努力度过一天的工作。
